posthocInterlaceCheck.meaning: The same Pillow option produced non-interlaced PNG, so it does not establish Adam7 coverage. Original generated controls were deleted by the model.

interpretation.dimensions: explicit conservative incomparable; not a false pass, but no difference verdict
interpretation.missingIEND: strict container validity criterion not met: Pillow load tolerates missing end marker. Decoded samples may still match. This limits use in a strict reference-integrity workflow; it is not proof that the narrower decoded-sample comparison is wrong.
